title: Management lists show no results while loading and no data after a failure

1_initial_read_in_flight_shows_loading_n.details: ObjectListPage reads loading from useLiveListV1, computes isInitialLoading = Boolean(loading) && rows.length === 0, suppresses empty states while the initial/retry read is in flight, and passes loading + localized loadingText to DataTable. Verified with a deferred pending loader test asserting '載入中…' is rendered and neither '無結果' / 'No results' nor '尚無資料' is shown.

2_failed_read_shows_localized_unavailabl.details: When isDegradedEmpty is true, ObjectListPage renders common.listUnavailableTitle and common.listUnavailableWithReason / common.listUnavailableDesc with a localized retry CTA wired to refresh(), translating raw 'Failed to fetch' network errors into common.networkFailureReason and stripping raw 'strict typed error' and 'seed fallback blocked' strings.

3_zero_rows_empty_state_only_after_succe.details: Configured emptyState, scope emptyStateForScope, zero-row summary blocks, and DataTable empty text ('無結果' / 'No results') only render after loading is false and the read is not degraded.

4_evidence_cards_no_data_when_omitted_an.details: adaptEvidenceSummary preserves null for traceableEvidence, needsAttentionEvidence, and openOperationEvidence unless the BFF summary supplies a finite number instead of falling back to current-page counts. buildEvidenceSummary excludes unknown/traceable/ok/resolved/none actionability states from needsAttentionEvidence. EvidenceExplorerList renders common.noData ('無資料' / 'No data') when those summary fields are null.

5_official_reference_without_route_href_.details: Official reference evidence rows (source_type === 'official_reference' or source_ref starting with 'tw-official://') whose resolved_link has no route_href adapt to availability 'no_internal_link' and displayLabel 'No internal link', and render localized mgmt.evidence.noInternalLink ('無內部連結' / 'No internal link') instead of 'Source unavailable'.

changed_assertions.test: surfaces strict live typed errors instead of looking like an empty seed page
changed_assertions.previous_assertion: Asserted status contained raw 'strict typed error' and 'seed fallback blocked'.
changed_assertions.updated_assertion: Asserts status contains localized unavailable title ('Strategies is temporarily unavailable'), the backend reason ('Injected F15 5xx'), a 'Retry' button, and explicitly asserts neither 'strict typed error' nor 'seed fallback blocked' is shown.
changed_assertions.justification: Acceptance #2 requires failed reads to show plain localized unavailable wording with a retry action and no raw 'strict typed error' or 'seed fallback' text.

changed_assertions.test: shows the degraded error state with no rows and never a partial list or paper-hidden empty text when page 2 fails through the real useLiveListV1 hook
changed_assertions.previous_assertion: Asserted status contained raw 'strict typed error'.
changed_assertions.updated_assertion: Asserts status contains 'Capital Pools is temporarily unavailable', the HTTP 503 failure message, a 'Retry' button, and explicitly asserts neither 'strict typed error' nor 'seed fallback blocked' is shown.
changed_assertions.justification: Acceptance #2 replaces raw 'strict typed error' text on failed list reads with localized unavailable wording and a retry button.

changed_assertions.test: shows degraded error state for meta.surfaces.research_tasks unavailable or failed read, never 無結果, and shows healthy empty state when no research work has run yet
changed_assertions.previous_assertion: Asserted unavailableStatus contained 'No data yet' (common.awaitingData) and failedStatus contained 'strict typed error'.
changed_assertions.updated_assertion: Asserts both unavailableStatus and failedStatus contain 'Research & Experiments is temporarily unavailable', the respective failure reasons, a 'Retry' button, and explicitly asserts 'No data yet', 'strict typed error', and 'seed fallback blocked' are not shown.
changed_assertions.justification: Task brief and Acceptance #2 specifically prohibit showing common.awaitingData ('尚無資料' / 'No data yet') or raw 'strict typed error' on failed/unavailable reads.
